q.whatIs: What is Creadora and what is it for?
q.vsChatgpt: How is it different from ChatGPT or Gemini?
q.generatesContent: Will Creadora create the content for me?
q.forWho: What type of creator is Creadora for?
q.multipleBriefs: Can I generate more than one brief for the same idea?
q.briefStatus: What does "Saved as content" mean in the brief status?
q.manualVsSuggested: What is the difference between a Manual and a Suggested idea?
q.location: What does the "Storage location" field mean?
q.identityPage: What is the Identity & Insights page?
q.emptyInsights: Why are my insights empty or very basic?
q.creatorPlan: What does the Creator plan include?

q.cancel: Can I cancel at any time?
q.training: Does Creadora use my ideas to train AI models?

a.whatIs: Creadora is a creative intelligence platform for content creators. It helps you capture and organize your ideas, generate structured briefs for each piece of content, and understand the patterns of your creative production over time. It's not a tool to automatically generate content — it's a tool to make your creative process clearer, faster, and more yours.
a.vsChatgpt: Conversational AIs help you answer a question in the moment — but they don't remember who you are or how you think. Creadora accumulates memory of your creative process: your ideas, your topics, your patterns, your style. Over time, the suggestions you receive are based on what you've created, not a generic answer for anyone.
a.generatesContent: Not in the sense of producing it — Creadora doesn't generate videos, images, or designs. What it does is deliver a brief very close to the material you need: the creative angle, the opening hook, the suggested tone, and the structure developed specifically for the format and platform you chose. A brief for an Instagram Reel is different from one for a long YouTube video. Soon the brief will go a step further with an even more detailed development of each section.
a.forWho: For creators who take their process seriously. It works for independent creators, community managers, marketing teams, and agencies working with multiple brands.
a.whereToStart: Start with Ideas & Topics. Create your first idea, add topics, choose the platform, format, and content role, and generate your first brief. A key tip: the more details you include in your idea's context — tone, target audience, references you like — the more tailored the brief will be to what you actually have in mind. An idea with rich context produces a brief that's almost ready to use.
a.whatIsBrief: It's the structured guide that the platform generates from your idea and your parameter combination. It includes the creative angle, the opening hook, the suggested tone, and the step-by-step content structure. You can rate each section, request alternatives if something doesn't convince you, and approve it when you're satisfied with the result.
a.whatAreTopics: Topics are the thematic categories you work with as a creator — for example: digital marketing, recipes, travel, technology. They are the foundation the platform uses to get to know you. The more ideas you associate with your topics, the more personalized the suggestions you'll receive.
a.multipleBriefs: Yes. You can generate as many briefs as combinations you want to explore — changing the platform, format, or role. Each different combination generates an independent brief. If you want to try the same set of parameters with a different idea context, you can duplicate the idea and generate from the copy.
a.briefStatus: It means you already created a content from that brief. The brief fulfilled its purpose — the guide it generated is now linked to a record on your Contents page.
a.editBrief: You can request alternatives for any section that doesn't convince you — up to 10 times per section. If the result is partially good but you want to adjust something specific, you can use the alternatives as a base and edit the text directly in your preferred tool after downloading the brief.
a.manualVsSuggested: Manual ideas are ones you created directly. Suggested ideas are ones the platform generated from your topics and previous contents. In both cases, the idea is yours — the difference is the origin.
a.contentsPage: It's the record of everything you've created or plan to create. You can add contents you've already published to feed Creadora's intelligence, register the contents you're producing from your briefs, and use filters to find any piece by platform, format, status, or date.
a.location: It's the place where you store the files for that content — it could be your phone, laptop, Google Drive, external hard drive, or another cloud service. It's not a geographic location. This field is optional and helps you find your files easily when you need them.
a.identityPage: It's where the platform shows you what it has learned about your creative process. You'll see the distribution of your topics, formats, and platforms, as well as strategic insights about your production. The deep Creative Report offers a complete analysis of your identity as a creator based on everything you've registered.
a.emptyInsights: Because the platform needs data to learn. The more ideas, topics, and contents you register, the more precise and personalized the insights will be. With at least 10 ideas and some contents, you'll start seeing significant patterns.
a.activityPage: It's the record of your consistency and growth as a creator. It shows when and how frequently you produce content, how your production has evolved over time, and on which platforms you're most active.
a.freePlan: Yes. The Free plan is permanent and allows you to capture ideas, register contents, and explore the platform without a time limit. AI features require the Creator plan.
a.creatorPlan: Full access to all AI features: brief generation, strategic insights, deep creative report, and personalized idea suggestions. It also includes brief export in Word format.
a.trial: Yes. New users get a 14-day free trial of the Creator plan with no payment information required.
a.cancel: Yes. You can manage your subscription — including cancellation — from the My Profile section at any time.
a.training: No. Your ideas, briefs, and contents are yours. We don't use them to train AI models or share them with third parties. Data is processed solely to generate responses for you within the platform.
a.security: Yes. All information is stored with encryption in transit and at rest, with strict access policies. You can request the deletion of your account and all your data at any time by writing to hello@usecreadora.com.
